title.en: The Medicine Bag (Virginia Driving Hawk Sneve)

hook.en: A teenager boasts about his Sioux grandfather to his friends, then dreads the day the old man actually visits. The *Medicine Bag* is about heritage, pride and growing up.

body.en: Martin, the narrator, and his sister live in a city in Iowa. Martin enjoys telling friends romantic tales of his Lakota (Sioux) great-grandfather, but is embarrassed when the old man, frail and in traditional clothes, arrives unexpectedly after a long journey from the reservation in South Dakota. Grandpa has come to give Martin the family medicine bag, a pouch of sacred objects passed down through the generations. To Martin's surprise, his friends are fascinated and respectful. Grandpa tells him the *story* of their ancestor Iron Shell's vision quest and explains that Martin must add a sprig of sage from the reservation. Grandpa dies soon after; Martin goes to the reservation and places the sage in the bag. Read the prescribed text itself; this guide is in our own words and quotes nothing.

body.en: The story is about cultural identity: Martin lives between the mainstream city world and his Lakota heritage, and must choose to honour the latter. It is also about the bond between generations and about the difference between stereotypes (the tall tales, and his fear of what friends think) and real people. The *medicine bag* symbolises heritage, identity and responsibility; the sage represents Martin's own contribution, linking him to the land and to the tradition. The first-person narration lets us share Martin's embarrassment and his growth.

problem.en: What is the significance of the title The Medicine Bag?

steps.en: The bag is the central object, passed from generation to generation.
It carries the family's history and the story of Iron Shell's vision.
Receiving it is Martin's rite of passage into responsibility for his heritage.
His adding the sage shows he accepts and continues the tradition.

answer.en: The bag stands for heritage and identity, and Martin's acceptance of it marks his growing up.
